test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘COVER’ is written as ‘18522153’ and ‘STINK’ is written as ‘111492019’. How will ‘PLATE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

Logic: The positional value of alphabets are written in reverse order.

'COVER’ is written as ‘18522153'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c1a9917a92b803fa95e3aa4602561028e7ab3fb4fa7d98c91daabb80590c579.png] 

And,

‘STINK’ is written as ‘111492019’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749d12296abeefafff682332f5dc68a9364da69f855ce8e188f79b0f7eda1f8f.png] 

Similarly,

‘PLATE’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55cab29b602db98e2ce884d19ba22ad1fe33a71fff90a707c202829cf02be5d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"52011216".**
